scope: Installation prerequisites only; not desktop, transaction, debugger or market acceptance

environment.isolation: Mount, PID and network namespaces; ordinary UID 1000; no network

observations.detail: Wineboot cleanup returned TreeTermination. Process snapshot showed orphaned Wine descendants as zombies parented to Python PID 1.

The same 7-Zip payload and runtime installed into a fresh prefix under tini. Completion snapshot contained only tini, the fixture, Xvfb, CLI and ps; no Wine process remained. Production cleanup was not weakened.

7-Zip and Notepad++ returned success and expected launchers existed. SumatraPDF returned exit success but its declared launcher did not exist: the default installer wrote to per-user AppData/Local instead of declared Program Files. This confirms process exit alone cannot certify installation.

A separate fresh prefix with the same installer and explicit -install -silent -d destination produced the expected Program Files/SumatraPDF/SumatraPDF.exe. The recipe is a fixture override pending its managed-install source change.

remaining: Managed generation activation, rollback, cancellation and uninstall
Real application file operations and desktop launch
